schema.description: Each future project is a self-contained folder at projects/<slug>/ containing only that project's content. Hub cards read this file. Keep products empty until a real project ships.

entry.href: Path fallback on the catalog host, e.g. /<slug>/
entry.featured: Boolean. Hub highlights this card when true
